title: RS6 Avant Midnight Edition
description: A comprehensive dark aesthetic transformation of this RS6 Avant. We began with a full respray in Midnight Obsidian — our proprietary satin-finish deep black — complemented by carbon-fibre front splitter, side skirt extensions and rear diffuser. Twenty-two-inch forged monobloc wheels replace the factory setup, wrapped in bespoke tyres. The exterior is sealed beneath a full-coverage paint-protection film with a ceramic top coat.

title: G63 AMG Monochrome
description: The iconic G-Wagen received a head-to-toe monochrome treatment. Factory chrome brightwork was deleted and colour-coded to the hand-painted Obsidian Black Metallic body. Inside, we re-trimmed every surface in quilted Nappa leather with contrasting micro-stitching, reshaped the centre console and fitted bespoke aluminium tread-plates bearing the owner's initials.

title: Defender 110 Overland
description: Purpose-built for the client who refuses to compromise between capability and elegance. A full-wrap in desert sand matte was paired with a bespoke roof rack, rock-slider side steps and a winch-ready front bumper, all finished in textured satin black. The LED lightbar and spot-lamp array are concealed behind a custom grille insert that blends seamlessly with the factory face.

title: M3 Touring Isle of Man
description: One of the most striking M3 Tourings in private ownership. We colour-shifted this Competition into a satin-finish Isle of Man Green deep wrap, fitted a full Akrapovič titanium exhaust system and installed a staggered set of 20/21-inch BBS FI-R wheels. The rear diffuser and kidney-grille surrounds were painted gloss black to anchor the aggressive stance.

title: Panamera Turbo Shadow
description: The Panamera's executive grand-tourer brief taken to its absolute limit. A complete interior re-trim in two-tone midnight-blue and graphite quilted leather, paired with piano-black alcantara headlining and bespoke door-card inserts. Twenty-one-inch Exclusive Design wheels in satin black complement the factory Volcano Grey Metallic exterior, sealed beneath our premium ceramic coating.

title: Cullinan Black Badge Bespoke
description: An extraordinary commission for a client who already owned extraordinary taste. Working alongside the client over three months, we specified and delivered a complete bespoke interior featuring hand-embroidered star-mapping headlining, solid silver inlay marquetry panels and a complete leather re-colour in a shade mixed exclusively for the owner. The exterior received our finest ceramic paint correction and 10H coating application.
